newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted at mixed levels on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted at mixed levels on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted in bids and offers at mixed levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded on Tuesday versus none on Monday. Bids and offers included:
- Two barges, this week, Illinois River, bid at 205 percent of tariff, up five percentage points, offered 220 percent, no comparison.
- One barge, this week, mid-Mississippi River bid at 210 percent of tariff, unchanged, similar, no offer.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio River, no bid, offer 205 percent, down 10 percentage points, similar.
- One barge, next week, Illinois River, bid at 195 percent, offered at 205 percent.
- Four barges, two each weeks of November 3 and 10, Mid-Mississippi, no bid, offered 215 percent.
- Four barges, one each week November, Illinois River, bid 170 percent, offer 180 percent.
